# Events, commands and settings of docs/audit/7-triage.md the long list
# does not show: the console's level saved with the host settings, the
# deprecated CheckForFinishedDownload command and what it logs, and the
# Import Complete notification of a manual import without a download.
# A recording of its own; same format as ../golden/requests.txt.
#
#   GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-events/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-events make golden

# ConsoleLogLevel: stored as sent, read back, then blank again. The
# fixture's AllowedHosts, `*`, is refused by the form: blank it is.
config-host GET /api/v3/config/host
config-host-put-console PUT /api/v3/config/host bodies/config-host-put-console.json
config-host-console GET /api/v3/config/host
config-host-put-console-blank PUT /api/v3/config/host bodies/config-host-put-console-blank.json

# The command third-party callers used before RefreshMonitoredDownloads:
# run, as the refresh, and a warning in the log.
command-check-finished POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-check-finished.json
sleep 6
command-check-finished-get GET /api/v3/command/{id:command-check-finished}
log-warnings GET /api/v3/log?page=1&pageSize=50&sortKey=time&sortDirection=descending&level=warn

# A file no download client knows, imported by hand: the webhook that
# takes Import Complete only is told, with no download id.
mock - POST /mock/notifications/clear
notification-create-import-complete POST /api/v3/notification bodies/notification-create-import-complete.json
mock - POST /mock/fs/write?path=/downloads/manual/The.Pitt.S01E05.1080p.WEB.H264-Fixture/The.Pitt.S01E05.1080p.WEB.H264-Fixture.mkv&clip=episode
command-manual-import-untracked POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-manual-import-untracked.json
sleep 12
command-manual-import-untracked-get GET /api/v3/command/{id:command-manual-import-untracked}
mock manualimport-untracked-notifications GET /mock/notifications
